text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...The sky is getting bright. Which means 
it's already morning, huh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Shoot. Well, I'll keep getting ready for 
now, and leave the calculations I couldn't 
wrap up as an assignment for tonight—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, what a pathetic yawn, even for me. 
I knew full well that I should have gone 
to bed early, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I must make sure to keep myself pulled 
together in front of Trainer-kun.

So engrossed in her thoughts was Biwa 
Hayahide that she was unable to get enough 
sleep last night...
